free_tier.stated: No free tier. On-demand H100 GPUs from USD 3.59 per GPU-hour on the vendor page, and USD 2.51 per GPU-hour on the index read 2026-10-27. Rates are indicative floors set at allocation by a bid and ask across 40 or more supply providers; H200 and Blackwell are by request through sales. The index lists no A100, L40S, RTX 4090 or L4.

chaining: An aggregator of other hosts' capacity with a floor price that moves at allocation; the H100 is the only self-serve card. It is not a source for the A100, L40S, RTX 4090 or L4.
limits_note: No quota is stated: the published rate is an indicative floor and the exact rate is set at allocation, so the price is the open variable.
